In order to Lojbanize scientific terms to Lojban the following conventions are used:
#names of organs, names of widespread animals and plants are to be taken from major languages so that they are easier memorized
#Linnaean names, names of specific organs are to prefixed: animals with '''dal-''', plants with '''spa-'''
#:dalko'ala - koala, dalgeko - gecko
